LESSON: FRIENDSHIP FORMATION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.1: Friendship Formation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Friendship Formation, part of Christian Living in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: how to avoid negative peer influence’. Why is it important to have good friends?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

B. At home with your parent or guardian

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skill of communicating clearly and effectively is exhibited as learners discuss the

importance of having good friends.

• Digital literacy: the skill of connecting using technology is enhanced as learners brainstorm on the topic ‘how to avoid

negative peer influence’ and make power point presentations.

• Love: learners portray a caring attitude towards their friends.
